name: SikaBond INSTANT NAILS FAST
paste:
SIKABOND® INSTANT NAILS FAST: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST, November 2025, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sikabond_instantnailsfast.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST is a premium, gap filling, water based, multi purpose construction adhesive providing strong initial grab and high bond strength.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST can be used on most substrates due to its excellent adhesion.
    - Fixing polystyrene wall panels
    - Replacing loose tiles on walls
    - Skirting boards, architraves and trims to walls
    - Bonding panels and sheeting to internal wall studs
    - Bonding particleboard, plywood, fibre cement and strip flooring to joists
    - Bonding metal, glass, aluminium,concrete, paper and cork
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Fast Cure Multipurpose Construction Adhesive
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (November 2025, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Reduces number of mechanical fasteners required to install floors or walls.
    - May be repositioned for up to 60 minutes after application
    - Reduces squeaking and nail ride in floors
    - Paintable with water based coatings
    - Easy to use one component
    - Bridges gaps up to 9 mm
    - Strong adhesion to metal
    - Solvent free
    - Dries white
    - High bond strength
    - Easy water clean up
    - Fast initial grab for vertical and horizontal positions
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: White
    - Density: ~1.4 kg/l
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Consistency: Thixotropic paste
    - Service temperature: -5°C to +90°C
    - Skinning time: ~20 minutes
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production.
2.7 Packaging.
    | 430 gram cartridge | 12 cartridges per box |
2.8 Storage conditions. The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion. All loose flaking material must be removed and light sanding is recommended.
    - SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST will adhere to damp (not wet) substrates but drying times may be extended. Substrates should be above 5°C. Do not bond 2 non-porous substrates ensure that one surface is porous.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - After the necessary substrate preparation, prepare the end of the cartridge before or after inserting into the sealant gun then fit the nozzle. Apply in beads, strips or spots at intervals of a few centimetres each. Use hand pressure only to fix the components to be bonded into position before skinning of the adhesive occurs. Incorrectly positioned components can easily be repositioned for approximately 60 minutes after application.
    - For butt joints use adhesive on both panel edges. If necessary, use temporary adhesive tapes, wedges, or supports to hold the assembled components together during the initial curing time. Fresh, uncured adhesive remaining on the surface must be removed immediately. Final strength will be reached after complete curing of SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST, after 24 to 48 hours at +23°C, depending on the environmental conditions and adhesive layer thickness
4.3 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use detergent and water.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Protect from contact with water.
    - High humidity or poor ventilation will result in slow curing.
    - Not suitable where both surfaces are non-porous.
    - In applications where load bearing is required mechanical fasteners must be used.
    - Not suitable for bonding plank or engineered timbers to concrete floors.
    - Do not use in permanently damp/wet conditions.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.4):
    - High humidity or poor ventilation will result in slow curing.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST, November 2025, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sikabond_instantnailsfast.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaBond Instant Nails Fast, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/MSDS%20SikaBond%20INSTANT%20NAILS%20FAST%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST, version 16/10/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sds-sikabond-instantnailsfast.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
